stability.note: The driver checked source and asset hashes at termination. The profiler stopped before normal completion. Tool-runtime replacement, a shell initialization failure and a broken tool connection were also observed; causation for the tracing error is unproved.

method: One fresh browser process; one empty browser context per sample. No priming sample or outlier is removed.
Heading paint preserves the earlier document.fonts.ready plus two animation-frame method. Stage paint preserves two frames after the actual full boot. Assets-ready is separate.
Warm starts at trusted caption pointerdown; Back must restore the actual click-time library scroll.
CPU throttling is applied before navigation. Network is local without emulated latency; OS caches and other applications are not controlled.
The explicit 300ms result covers only the recorded local routes/settings. It does not establish all-component startup, native CPU4 frame rate or Lighthouse acceptance.
Failure-only DOM/screenshot capture runs after the original measurement path throws or records a page error. Continuing inventory retains failures and does not turn them into passes.

integrationTest.scope: Integration fault adapter serves exact current static files except an explicitly hashed index injection. Only the desktop dark warm Library gets an unstable Show more button. This is not a product failure or timing-acceptance test. Both recorded expected failures remain failures.

rawEvidence.availability: Raw .artifacts files are local and gitignored; these measurements are published so a fresh clone has the actual recorded values. Do not execute archived private helpers/inputs.

deviceContext.meaning: Desktop Chromium contexts at 1440px and a compact 390px viewport; this is not physical mobile-device testing.
